snippet.title: Reworking my ENTIRE Game's Combat | Chemical Combat Devlog 3
snippet.description:
Hey guys, I'm back with another Chemical Combat devlog. In this one I'll discuss how I upgraded the combat from guns to potions, reworked the whole reaction system and fixed the game loop by adding proper upgrades. The game is getting close to release and should be almost done by the next devlog - hopefully you enjoy! 😄

🎮 Come wishlist Chemical Combat on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3490250/Chemical_Combat/


💬 Join my discord server here!
https://discord.com/invite/NxDSW65sUY

🙋‍♂️ Support the channel by subscribing!
https://www.youtube.com/@sigmoiddev

🎬 Check out the rest of the devlogs!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdCLXFnLGVkDi819PJWZBBoNhcDzZCGev


📖 Chapters:
0:00 - Intro
0:21 - Combat
1:28 - Alchemy
2:05 - Reactions & Content
2:27 - Map Rework
2:45 - Player Upgrades
3:36 - Game Loop
4:11 - Plans & Outro


🎶 Music:
massobeats - lucid | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tEzzsT4qsbU https://freetouse.com/music/massobeats/lucid
